question: Who is the cabinet minister of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry as of September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Piyush Goyal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Piyush Goyal is the current Cabinet Minister for the Ministry of Commerce and Industry in India as of September 2024.
 
• He has held this position since May 31, 2019, under the second term of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.
 
• In addition to Commerce and Industry, Piyush Goyal has also served in portfolios like Railways, Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, and Coal.
 
• As the Commerce and Industry Minister, he has been actively involved in promoting exports, attracting foreign direct investment (FDI), and implementing key trade policies.
 
• Under his leadership, India has worked towards free trade agreements (FTAs) with multiple nations to enhance global trade relations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Commerce and Industry:**

 
 
• The Ministry of Commerce and Industry is responsible for formulating and implementing policies for India's international trade and economic growth.
 
• It consists of two departments: the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) and the Department of Commerce.
 
• Key initiatives under the ministry include 'Make in India,' 'Startup India,' and 'Ease of Doing Business' reforms.
 
 
 
• **Free Trade Agreements (FTAs):**
 
 
• FTAs are arrangements between two or more countries that aim to reduce or eliminate trade barriers like tariffs and import quotas.
 
• India has signed FTAs with countries including Japan, South Korea, and ASEAN nations.
 
• Recent negotiations under Piyush Goyal have focused on FTAs with the UK, EU, and Canada.
 
 
 
• **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI):**
 
 
• FDI involves investments made by a company or individual in one country into business interests located in another country.
 
• India has seen a significant increase in FDI inflows under Piyush Goyal's tenure, with reforms in sectors like manufacturing, retail, and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Export Promotion:**
 
 
• Export promotion refers to efforts aimed at increasing the sale of domestic goods in international markets.
 
• Under Piyush Goyal, India has introduced several export incentives and schemes like RoDTEP (Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products).
 
• Key export sectors include textiles, pharmaceuticals, IT services, and engineering goods.
